items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: After I got with the Milton Larkin Loggins band, in 1936 is when I joined him.

ctx.x: So it was piano, drums, and the other guy was a violin player. Anderson Lacy, And we'd look at the silent movies, and they'd play the prettiest music -- but they were good musicians.

Now that was the only man who could teach us any instrument, but he didn't have the time. Now, let me tell you what we learned from him. After I got with the Milton Larkin Loggins band, in 1936 is when I joined him. Milton Larkin.
